_note: The Champion's breeding ranch (D-035). Its shape is decided (D-036 to D-040). Site locations stay PROPOSALS until Zack approves them; the planner shows what they would hold but never decides. Game facts marked 'believed' still need checking against the cartridge.
premise: Endgame of the whole saga: a Pokémon Champion with unlimited money and unlimited land across Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh, with Pokémon doing the work. Home for any past companion who retires there, and for the breeding stock the canon's lineages produced.

shape.rule: One headquarters. Satellites only where the headquarters can't give a resident its land.
shape.satellites_status: not chosen: the census shows one is needed (Sevii Islands or the Battle Zone)

residents_policy.rule: Left open: any companion may retire to the ranch, stay with family, go back to the wild or go with the rival. Nobody is assigned; the census counts every companion as a possible resident.

stock_policy.rule: Build the lineage, keep only the final product: one male of each target line who knows the whole egg-move set (the stud). The fathers used along the way are not kept. A line whose move comes from a held item keeps the item instead.

staffing_policy.rule: Both Pokémon and people. Pokémon jobs come from game-backed or authored capabilities; people roles are placeholders to author.

access.rule: Private ranch with one open feature: the Day-Care, a 'gazillionaire edition' of the games' Day-Care. Super exclusive and small, run like a wildlife preserve with a day-care side. Everything else is private.

sites.name: Blackthorn highlands (headquarters)
sites.anchor: Route 45 and Route 44, between Blackthorn City and Dark Cave
game_facts: Route 45 is a mountain road with a river; Dark Cave opens onto it (cartridge)
Ice Path links Blackthorn to Mahogany (cartridge)
Dragon's Den, the dragon clan's shrine, sits behind Blackthorn Gym (cartridge)
Route 44 has a lake and grass (cartridge)
sites.why: Home region of three chapters (Crystal, HeartGold, SoulSilver). One stretch of road gives mountains, a cave system, a river, real ice and a sacred site.
alternatives: Lake of Rage and Route 43 (a huge lake and open grassland)
Mt. Silver and Route 28 (the endgame mountain, snow at the summit in HGSS)
sites.heritage: Route 34 Day-Care in Goldenrod, Johto's breeding house (cartridge)

sites.name: Sevii Islands estate
game_facts: Mt. Ember volcano and the Ember Spa hot spring on Kindle Road, One Island (cartridge)
Icefall Cave and a Day-Care on Four Island (cartridge)
Sevault Canyon and the Tanoby Ruins on Seven Island (cartridge)

alternatives: Route 5 Day-Care and the Kanto mainland

sites.anchor: Route 117 (Verdanturf) with a second parcel at Lavaridge Town and Route 112
game_facts: The Hoenn Day-Care is on Route 117, among flower beds and a pond (cartridge)
Lavaridge Town has hot springs below Mt. Chimney (cartridge)

sites.name: Resort Area villa and the Battle Zone
sites.anchor: Platinum's Resort Area villa, with land across the Battle Zone (Routes 225-230, Stark Mountain)
game_facts: The Villa in the Resort Area can be bought in Platinum (believed: 50,000,000 Pokédollars; verify)
Stark Mountain is a volcano in the Battle Zone (cartridge)
Solaceon Town has Sinnoh's Day-Care and the Solaceon Ruins (cartridge)
Route 216 and 217 lie under constant snow (cartridge)
sites.why: The game's own house for a rich trainer, which fits a Champion with unlimited money. The Battle Zone adds sea, cliffs, desert and a volcano.
alternatives: Route 217 and Lake Acuity snowfields for cold-climate residents

hatchery_greenhouse.name: The Glasshouse
hatchery_greenhouse.idea: One building where eggs and plants share everything. Blackthorn sits against the Ice Path, so both need heat, and the heat comes from Pokémon. A Magcargo hearth at the core keeps the eggs warm; the greenhouse rings wrap around it and live on the same heat. Ampharos lights both through the winter. Eggs hatch by being walked, so the walk that hatches them runs through the crop rows: the egg walk is the harvest walk.
hatchery_greenhouse.loop_note: proposed: one lap of the hatching loop = one Gen 4 egg cycle (255 steps), so an egg's cycle count is its lap count

rooms.name: Hearth hall
rooms.what: the incubation core: egg racks in rings around a Magcargo hearth, sorted by line

rooms.name: Glasshouse rings
rooms.what: berry beds and Apricorn trees wrapped around the hearth, warmed by it and lit by Ampharos in the dark months

rooms.name: Hatching loop
rooms.what: the walking path that winds through the glasshouse rows; eggs are carried around it until they hatch

rooms.name: Nursery yard
rooms.what: where hatchlings take their first steps and first meals: berries from the rings, Miltank's milk

rooms.name: Cold vault
rooms.what: cut into the Ice Path rock: the seed vault and the berry store

rooms.name: Studbook office
rooms.what: pedigrees and the full PKHeX card of every egg that hatches

crops.note: Medicine berries for the clinic and the nursery, plus every berry a canon build holds (read from builds.json). Apricorns for Kurt's Poké Balls grow outside the glass.
